description: This file implements functions for a Web Roo Fsm Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It defines object lifecycle methods, function pointers, and sets up the object structure for a web server finite state machine component.

classes.name: WEB_ROO_FSM_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing the Web Roo Finite State Machine object, containing function pointers for FSM operations and internal state variables.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE WebRooFsmCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new WebRooFsm object, allocating memory and setting up function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooFsmRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the WebRooFsm object by calling the appropriate cleanup functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooFsmEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary sub-objects or components required by the FSM.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooFsmInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the FSM object, setting function pointers and base class initialization.
